confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Granada's Andalusian tourist pricing, not live listings. Restaurant and café anchors are moderately confident; accommodation (especially hostel and 3-star) is less certain and seasonal, since July is peak season. Cocktail and wine were estimated from the beer anchor because direct knowledge is weaker. FX could not be verified: two RBA-related searches returned no authoritative RBA observation (only conflicting third-party figures), so the fx fields are null rather than guessed.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is Andalusian mid-sized tourist cities such as Seville, Cordoba and Malaga, adjusted slightly below Malaga and Seville for Granada's lower hotel and restaurant pricing outside the Alhambra core.
